english.title: Transport animals on roll-on-roll-off vessel in Wales when matters not verified

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Welfare of Animals Transport Wales Order 2007

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or excuse transported animals, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..) on a roll-on-roll-off vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), when the master of the vessel had not first verified the matters referred to in point 3.1 of Chapter II of Annex I to Council Regulation (EC) No 1/2005 relating to additional provisions for transport on roll-on-roll-off vessels
english.legislation: Contrary to article 7(2) of the Welfare of Animals (Transport) (Wales) Order 2007, sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
without lawful authority or excuse
transported animals on a roll-on-roll-off vessel
when the master of the vessel had not first verified that
the vessel was equipped with an appropriate forced ventilation system
and was fitted with an alarm system and an adequate secondary source of power in case of failure on enclosed decks OR
adequate protection from sea water was provided on open decks

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant without lawful authority or excuse transported animals, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..) on a roll-on-roll-off vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), when the master of the vessel had not first verified the matters referred to in point 3.1 of Chapter II of Annex I to Council Regulation (EC) No 1/2005 relating to additional provisions for transport on roll-on-roll-off vessels.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and/or a level 5 fineTime limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
